info.name: Indexia Finance — Loans API
info.description: All loan products (Personal, Business, Home, LAP, Balance Transfer, Project Loan, Vehicle Loan) with apply/list + admin endpoints. Set baseUrl, then run the Auth folder first — it saves {{userToken}} / {{adminToken}} automatically.

request.description: Sends OTP. With the dev STATIC_OTP the code is always 123456.

exec: // nothing to save here; OTP is static in dev

request.description: Employment types allowed for a loanType: personal | business | home | lap.
All states for the dependent dropdowns.
Cities for one state — feed it the selected state.
Pincodes for a state+city pair (dependent lookup). Empty list = city has no seeded pincodes; the form falls back to the Other pincode input.
Bank master for transaction/salary bank selectors.
Profession list for Self Employed - Professional.
Status Of Business Place list for both self-employed types.
Every master as { type: values } — plus separate banks + locations views.
